_a.stranger.in_passing: Bastian Passing unpacked a stub of a pencil at T-F11. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

A bullet clipped Bastian Passing's helmet at T-F11 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Silas "Ash" Azhanselmc of the Concord (@azhanselmc). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Bastian Passing helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

A bullet struck Bastian Passing below the ribs at T-F11. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Cyril Connorboi of the Concord (@connorboi308). The bearers reached Bastian Passing at T-F11 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Cyril Connorboi of the Concord (@connorboi308).

Cyril Passing arrived carrying the family name of Bastian Passing. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Cyril Passing could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Cyril Passing took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at T-F11, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Roland Dr of the Concord (@dr8427932). Cyril Passing was killed outright at T-F11, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Roland Dr of the Concord (@dr8427932).
Teodor "Owl" Passing put a stub of a pencil beside the bunk. Someone who had known Cyril Passing helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Teodor "Owl" Passing saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Bastian Tartochuk, grazed.
ana_serrano_7: The new rifleman is Isidor Serrano, once a tram conductor from Old Harrow. The corporal asked if a tram conductor was any use in a trench. Isidor Serrano said he would find out.
Number 56 on the early rolls: Isidor Serrano. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.
The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In R-F14, Isidor Serrano listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Isidor Serrano found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Isidor Serrano dreamt he was back in Old Harrow, working as a tram conductor. He woke up and said nothing all morning.

Isidor Serrano's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Isidor Serrano wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Isidor Serrano took a message across the Sunken Road at dusk. The message arrived. Isidor Serrano did not.
Found with a party from another section, Isidor Serrano was guided back to R-F14. The relief on the corporal's face lasted until the lecture began.

The men at R-F14 heard Isidor Serrano call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Bastian "Lucky" Vpy of the Concord (@v01py). Clean sheets, a lamp, and a surgeon. Isidor Serrano was admitted to the hospital dugout and finally let go of his rifle. The worst has passed for Isidor Serrano. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly.
Isidor Serrano drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.

For days Isidor Serrano was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle. The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Isidor Serrano helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

An officer asked who was writing the menus. Isidor Serrano admitted it and waited. The officer asked for a copy to send home. Victory at Grey Mill. Isidor Serrano let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Isidor Serrano fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Karel Zzkaake, now badly wounded.
Isidor Serrano drew the street leading to Old Harrow. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.
consumable.panda: Hugo Panda came up the line with a tin whistle and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Hugo Panda wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Jonas Mars lent Hugo Panda a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
Hugo Panda heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.
crab.91078893: The new sniper is Arno "Bones" Crab, once a baker from Esterhaus. The corporal asked if a baker was any use in a trench. Arno "Bones" Crab said he would find out.

A round came through the loophole Arno "Bones" Crab was watching at Q-F19 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack of the Concord (@hughesjack02). Arno "Bones" Crab was killed at Q-F19 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack of the Concord (@hughesjack02).

Viktor "Ash" Crab took the same post at Q-F19 where Arno "Bones" Crab stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. Orders assigned Viktor "Ash" Crab to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Viktor "Ash" Crab watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Viktor "Ash" Crab fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. A letter from home found Viktor "Ash" Crab before the night shift. Viktor "Ash" Crab folded it small and kept it close.
A bullet grazed Viktor "Ash" Crab's ribs at Q-F19. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Valentin Peebles of the Concord (@miles.peebles).
grantcsst: Day 9: Bastian "Shadow" Grantcsst reached S-C4 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Victory at Blackwater Canal. Bastian "Shadow" Grantcsst let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. A letter from home found Bastian "Shadow" Grantcsst before the night shift. Bastian "Shadow" Grantcsst folded it small and kept it close.

Frost made each footprint distinct. Bastian "Shadow" Grantcsst followed a trail to the missing ration sack and found the quartermaster sitting on it. A letter from home found Bastian "Shadow" Grantcsst before the night shift. Bastian "Shadow" Grantcsst folded it small and kept it close. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Bastian "Shadow" Grantcsst is number 840. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Bastian "Shadow" Grantcsst shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Bastian "Shadow" Grantcsst added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
A newspaper reached Bastian "Shadow" Grantcsst with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
han_nes2012: Henrik Nes came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-C3, Henrik Nes listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Henrik Nes as a story about a general. The ending was the same. The clerk counted the names twice. Henrik Nes is number 785 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Henrik Nes kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Henrik Nes found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
Henrik Nes lent Oskar "Tin" Oscarwildely a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
jedrk_123: The quartermaster asked Rafael "Mole" Jedrk to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Rafael "Mole" Jedrk began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
The cook borrowed Rafael "Mole" Jedrk's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Rafael "Mole" Jedrk during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Rafael "Mole" Jedrk across the shin at S-S13. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Tobias "Brick" Blakeg of the Concord (@blakeg.p11). Rafael "Mole" Jedrk got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 479. The men who came later will ask about it. Rafael "Mole" Jedrk walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Rafael "Mole" Jedrk's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Word of Rafael "Mole" Jedrk's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
kaelan_dooley: Rafael "Owl" Dooley reached R-S2 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Rafael "Owl" Dooley. The men named it Inkwell and said it had chosen him.
Rafael "Owl" Dooley walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Rafael "Owl" Dooley fired at a movement across the wire at R-S2. The man went down: Pavel Jdavidfranci, badly wounded. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Rafael "Owl" Dooley answered to number 590. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-S2 changed before the cheering ended. Rafael "Owl" Dooley shouldered another load.

The sergeant at R-S2 called out a range and a spot. Rafael "Owl" Dooley was the only one who hit it. Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat was grazed. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-S2 and grazed Rafael "Owl" Dooley's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Wendel Jaceaustin of the Concord (@jaceaustin_94).
Rafael "Owl" Dooley walked back up the communication trench to R-S2, slower than before, but on his own feet.
kraljmk87: Otto "Spark" Kraljmk joined the replacements on Day 10. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

A parcel came for Otto "Spark" Kraljmk that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping. After the loss of Grey Mill, Otto "Spark" Kraljmk helped stack spare sandbags at U-F18. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Otto "Spark" Kraljmk had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Ivo Oficera was grazed.
The parcel's address was smudged. Otto "Spark" Kraljmk took it to the clerk, who found two possible units and no reason to hurry.
leuttne: Nobody asked Walter "Hollow" Leuttne why he came. Nobody in S-C8 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Walter "Hollow" Leuttne read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Walter "Hollow" Leuttne started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here." The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Walter "Hollow" Leuttne answered to number 658. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Walter "Hollow" Leuttne watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A round went through the rim of Walter "Hollow" Leuttne's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Yann Somosmagios of the Hegemony (@somosmagios.bo).
Walter "Hollow" Leuttne stopped talking around midday. The medic took one look and called for a stretcher.
rambam5000: Hugo "Mud" Rambam arrived at U-F11 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

Hugo "Mud" Rambam carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Hugo "Mud" Rambam shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Hugo "Mud" Rambam owes Cyril Drawtoss so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Hugo "Mud" Rambam across the shin at U-F11. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Albin "Tin" Krut of the Concord (@krut4s3k).
romanbhassell: The sergeant gave Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 3 or any other.

Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Jonas Solyommadar crossed it, Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel fired. Jonas Solyommadar was grazed. Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel transferred to the sappers. The men in R-F6 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

A direct hit on the trench at R-F6. Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel was the only one they could still help, and only just. Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel was killed outright by a direct hit at R-F6. The men dug for an hour and found only his identity disc.
The House of Romanbhassel sent another. Anselm Romanbhassel, brother of Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.

Anselm Romanbhassel polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. A letter from home reached Anselm Romanbhassel before dusk. Anselm Romanbhassel read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Anselm Romanbhassel watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Anselm Romanbhassel came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire. The stretcher bearers took Anselm Romanbhassel in on a busy morning in R-F6. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Anselm Romanbhassel lent Dietrich Linningorchi a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. A letter from home reached Anselm Romanbhassel before dusk. Anselm Romanbhassel read it twice and slept a little easier.

An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Anselm Romanbhassel helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else. A letter from home reached Anselm Romanbhassel before dusk. Anselm Romanbhassel read it twice and slept a little easier.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Anselm Romanbhassel closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.

Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Anselm Romanbhassel helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years. A letter from home reached Anselm Romanbhassel before dusk. Anselm Romanbhassel read it twice and slept a little easier.

A flare lit Grey Mill like noon. Anselm Romanbhassel counted the seconds until darkness: eleven. A letter from home reached Anselm Romanbhassel before dusk. Anselm Romanbhassel read it twice and slept a little easier. Anselm Romanbhassel got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 199. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Anselm Romanbhassel helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
A trench mortar bomb landed in the next section of trench. The blast caught Anselm Romanbhassel at R-F6 and the bearers came at a run.
The medics called Anselm Romanbhassel 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Anselm Romanbhassel is back on the line.
somka5221: Henrik Somka told the sergeant he was a dance-hall violinist. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
The old Private did not come back from the wire. Henrik Somka wears his stripes now: Lance Corporal.
A pump handle snapped off in Henrik Somka's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Henrik Somka pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.

A bullet hit Henrik Somka's belt buckle at S-S13 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Dietrich Fokai of the Concord (@tru_og_fokai). Henrik Somka walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Henrik Somka's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-S13 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. The clerk counted the names twice. Henrik Somka is number 465 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Henrik Somka could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Henrik Somka found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
A rat stole Henrik Somka's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
thephatrat6060: The new stretcher bearer gave his name as Marek Thephatrat. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Marek Thephatrat during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Marek Thephatrat fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Jakub "Saint" Smx, badly wounded. A letter from home reached Marek Thephatrat before dusk. Marek Thephatrat read it twice and slept a little easier.
A bullet went through Marek Thephatrat's sleeve at P-F15 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Teodor Timmy of the Concord (@timmy7jc).
triskit166: Viktor Triskit arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a tin of tobacco and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Viktor Triskit stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Viktor Triskit changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument. After the loss of Grey Mill, Viktor Triskit helped stack spare sandbags at T-F1. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A sniper's bullet hit Viktor Triskit at T-F1. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Otto Dalev of the Hegemony (@dalev44). A single shot at T-F1. Viktor Triskit sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Otto Dalev of the Hegemony (@dalev44).
Marek Triskit had heard about Viktor Triskit's courage. At T-F1, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Marek Triskit felt a hard tug at his hip at T-F1. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Norbert Ware of the Hegemony (@the_real_brennan_ware).
